data.title: Denial of water-law permit for a boat dock at Musterower See
data.summary: The Untere Wasserbehörde of Landkreis Beispiel-Seenplatte denied Wiebke Musterholm's 15 September 2025 application to build a 12 m wooden boat dock (Bootssteg) at Am Fischerhafen 4, because it would destroy about 40 m² of a legally protected reed bed (Röhrichtbestand) and the nature conservation authority refused an exception. No fee was charged for this decision.
data.explanation: The water authority (Untere Wasserbehörde) has refused the building permit for your boat dock because it would damage a protected reed bed, and a nearby communal dock exists as an alternative. No fee is charged for this decision. You may decide whether to file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Landkreis to challenge the refusal; the app shows the deadline by which it must arrive. If you do nothing within that time, the decision becomes final. Since this involves nature-conservation law, getting advice from a lawyer or the Naturschutzbehörde before deciding may help.
